column1: # W49 LIP energy-term necessity, Module-A-v2 lineage.
# WHY. app:method-details defines E_b = H_b + C_b + G_b + R_b over 12 lines but
# no measurement supports any one term. The only prior drop-one sweep
# (05a_r40_cdct_a01_drop_pent_*) predates the v2 energy: it used
# conf x (S+H+C+G+R) at r=0.40 with CDCT tokens, so it cannot speak for the
# current formula. Separately, every adopted arm hardcodes the policy suffix
# the removal of S is a live design decision that the paper states in one
# sentence and never tests. This queue measures all five terms at once.
# HOW. Knockouts are policy tokens, not env flags. GEOPACT_POLICY_EXTRA
# (added W49) appends a suffix to the v2 policy string; the value "none"
# drops back to the bare v2 policy, which is the with-S control. Parsing
# ANCHORS. Both cells copy the adopted 8B ScreenSpot-v2 arms verbatim:
# The base rows re-measure those anchors under this queue so every delta is
# read against a twin launched from the same TSV, not against a legacy number.
